about_the_game:
A TASTE OF TEMPTATION.

Begin the journey. Desire awaits... just out of reach.



You play as an 18-year-old girl from a quiet town, living a simple life alongside your childhood best friend, Michelle. But after your father’s passing and your mother’s growing struggles, you're faced with a life-changing choice.

One day, Michelle reaches out from the big city of Alivara with a promising offer: a place to stay and a job at her studio. With nothing holding you back, you take the leap—ready to start over.

This demo version lets you experience the beginning of a seductive journey: from small-town innocence to big-city allure. Explore the setup, meet the characters, and feel the tension build—right up to the moment before everything changes.

Will you stop now... or dive deeper into desire in the full game?




  • A kinetic visual novel with a focus on emotional and erotic tension
  • Meet the cast and set the stage for a journey of seduction
  • Preview the story's atmosphere, writing, and art style
  • No explicit content—just a tease of what's to come
  • Perfect for players curious about the full experience

Note: This demo contains no sexual content or explicit CGs. It serves as an introduction to the story, ending just before the first erotic scene. The full game is intended for adults (18+) only.
